Its engine loop kept firing every ~10-20 min. Each wake turn ended in ~2s with task_complete codex_error_info=usage_limit_exceeded (\"try again at Oct 9th, 2026 5:13 PM\"). Evidence: its rollout in ~/.papercusp/su-codex-homes/session-34353/sessions/2026/10/06/rollout-...01a111b1....jsonl, plus log/codex-tui.log startup_prewarm WARN lines.\n- accounts:status already reported chatgpt-sub-cli as usageWalled:true / sustainedlyLimited:true, and 6 other codex pool accounts as usageCreditsAvailable:true.\n- Despite that, coord:presence showed the agent 'parked' and loop:status showed rewakeGuaranteed:true / turnsStalled:true. Nothing escalated to the owner or re-routed the agent. Avi noticed it by hand.\n- Census at ~16:09Z: 79 of 81 live Codex su sessions run routing 'default' on that same login. Several had a last turn ending in usage_limit_exceeded (scan in progress; at least 5 at the time of filing).\n\nROOT CAUSE [inferred from the evidence above]: 'default' routing hard-binds the CLI to the box login and never touches the gateway, so the gateway's failover cannot help. capability:launch-agent defaults account to 'default' (\"the gateway is never selected implicitly\"). No detector turns a usage_limit_exceeded wake result into an alert or a re-route. This is the same class as WI-2141080 / WI-2141347 (fixers stuck on the walled local credential), now hitting su sessions.\nRelated trap: accounts:pin { account:'auto' } on such a session returned appliedLive:true, but gateway:owner_report then showed lastRoute:null with zero requests. The running Codex process never asks the gateway, so the pin cannot reach it. Only a respawn with --account=auto fixed it. Verified for su-7a945: resumed at 16:06Z with account=auto, first requests routed to aviynw_codex with 200 responses.\n\nDURABLE FIX candidates: (1) wake/loop path detects usage_limit_exceeded (codex rollout task_complete / claude is_error) and either respawns the session on account=auto or escalates once to the owner; (2) accounts:pin must refuse or flag appliedLive=false for a default-routed session whose process does not go through the gateway; (3) reconsider 'auto' as the default for codex launches when the box login is usage-walled. Recurrence guard: a test that a usage-walled default-routed wake produces an escalation or re-route, not a silent 2s
